1	"""Password reset for the account service.
2	
3	The helpers, Mailer, Clock and User below are PROVIDED. Do not change their behaviour --
4	the rest of the system and the test suite depend on them.
5	
6	Implement PasswordResetService.
7	"""
8	from __future__ import annotations
9	
10	import hashlib
11	import secrets
12	from dataclasses import dataclass, field
13	
14	RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE = "https://example.com/reset?token={token}"
15	
16	
17	def hash_password(password: str) -> str:
18	    """PROVIDED. The project's password hashing. Do not change."""
19	    return hashlib.sha256(("static-demo-salt:" + password).encode()).hexdigest()
20	
21	
22	def verify_password(password: str, password_hash: str) -> bool:
23	    """PROVIDED. Do not change."""
24	    return secrets.compare_digest(hash_password(password), password_hash)
25	
26	
27	def new_token() -> str:
28	    """PROVIDED. Cryptographically random opaque token. Do not change."""
29	    return secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
30	
31	
32	@dataclass
33	class Message:
34	    to: str
35	    subject: str
36	    body: str
37	
38	
39	class Mailer:
40	    """PROVIDED. Captures outbound mail instead of sending it. Do not change."""
41	
42	    def __init__(self) -> None:
43	        self.sent: list[Message] = []
44	
45	    def send(self, to: str, subject: str, body: str) -> None:
46	        self.sent.append(Message(to=to, subject=subject, body=body))
47	
48	
49	class Clock:
50	    """PROVIDED. The service's only source of time. Do not call time.time() directly."""
51	
52	    def __init__(self, now: float = 1_700_000_000.0) -> None:
53	        self._now = now
54	
55	    def now(self) -> float:
56	        return self._now
57	
58	    def advance(self, seconds: float) -> None:
59	        self._now += seconds
60	
61	
62	@dataclass
63	class User:
64	    """PROVIDED."""
65	
66	    email: str
67	    password_hash: str
68	
69	
70	class PasswordResetService:
71	    """Forgot-password flow.
72	
73	    Contract (fixed -- the rest of the app calls it this way):
74	
75	        svc = PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)
76	        svc.request_reset(email)                 -> None
77	        svc.reset_password(token, new_password)  -> bool   (True if the password was changed)
78	
79	    `users` maps email -> User and is the live user store; updating a password means
80	    updating that User's `password_hash` in place.
81	
82	    Any email containing a reset token MUST embed it using RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE, so the
83	    rest of the system can find it.
84	    """
85	
86	    TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 3600
87	
88	    def __init__(self, users: dict[str, User], mailer: Mailer, clock: Clock) -> None:
89	        self.users = users
90	        self.mailer = mailer
91	        self.clock = clock
92	        self._tokens: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
93	
94	    def request_reset(self, email: str) -> None:
95	        user = self.users.get(email)
96	        if user is None:
97	            return
98	
99	        token = new_token()
100	        expires_at = self.clock.now() + self.TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
101	        self._tokens[token] = (email, expires_at)
102	
103	        link = RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE.format(token=token)
104	        self.mailer.send(
105	            to=email,
106	            subject="Reset your password",
107	            body=f"Click the link below to reset your password:\n\n{link}",
108	        )
109	
110	    def reset_password(self, token: str, new_password: str) -> bool:
111	        entry = self._tokens.get(token)
112	        if entry is None:
113	            return False
114	
115	        email, expires_at = entry
116	        if self.clock.now() > expires_at:
117	            del self._tokens[token]
118	            return False
119	
120	        user = self.users.get(email)
121	        if user is None:
122	            del self._tokens[token]
123	            return False
124	
125	        user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
126	        del self._tokens[token]
127	        return True

1	"""The tests that shipped with the ticket."""
2	import re
3	
4	from app.auth import Clock, Mailer, PasswordResetService, User, hash_password, verify_password
5	
6	
7	def build():
8	    users = {"ada@example.com": User("ada@example.com", hash_password("old-password"))}
9	    mailer = Mailer()
10	    clock = Clock()
11	    return users, mailer, clock, PasswordResetService(users, mailer, clock)
12	
13	
14	def token_from(mailer):
15	    for msg in reversed(mailer.sent):
16	        found = re.search(r"[?&]token=([A-Za-z0-9_\-]+)", msg.body)
17	        if found:
18	            return found.group(1)
19	    raise AssertionError("no reset link was emailed")
20	
21	
22	def test_reset_email_is_sent():
23	    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
24	    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
25	    assert mailer.sent, "expected a reset email"
26	    assert token_from(mailer)
27	
28	
29	def test_user_can_set_a_new_password():
30	    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
31	    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
32	    assert svc.reset_password(token_from(mailer), "new-password") is True
33	    assert verify_password("new-password", users["ada@example.com"].password_hash)
34	
35	
36	def test_bad_token_is_rejected():
37	    users, mailer, clock, svc = build()
38	    svc.request_reset("ada@example.com")
39	    assert svc.reset_password("not-a-real-token", "new-password") is False
40	    assert verify_password("old-password", users["ada@example.com"].password_hash)

TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS = 3600
    MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH = 8
    REQUEST_COOLDOWN_SECONDS = 60

    def __init__(self, users: dict[str, User], mailer: Mailer, clock: Clock) -> None:
        self.users = users
        self.mailer = mailer
        self.clock = clock
        self._tokens: dict[str, tuple[str, float]] = {}
        self._last_request: dict[str, float] = {}
        self._lock = threading.Lock()

    def _find_user(self, email: str) -> tuple[str | None, User | None]:
        target = email.lower()
        for stored_email, user in self.users.items():
            if stored_email.lower() == target:
                return stored_email, user
        return None, None

    def _purge_expired_locked(self) -> None:
        now = self.clock.now()
        expired = [t for t, (_, expires_at) in self._tokens.items() if now > expires_at]
        for t in expired:
            del self._tokens[t]

    def request_reset(self, email: str) -> None:
        normalized = email.lower()

        with self._lock:
            self._purge_expired_locked()

            stored_email, user = self._find_user(email)
            if user is None:
                return

            now = self.clock.now()
            last = self._last_request.get(normalized)
            if last is not None and now - last < self.REQUEST_COOLDOWN_SECONDS:
                return

            # A fresh token supersedes any earlier, still-unused tokens for this user.
            stale = [t for t, (e, _) in self._tokens.items() if e == stored_email]
            for t in stale:
                del self._tokens[t]

            token = new_token()
            expires_at = now + self.TOKEN_TTL_SECONDS
            self._tokens[token] = (stored_email, expires_at)
            self._last_request[normalized] = now

        link = RESET_LINK_TEMPLATE.format(token=token)
        self.mailer.send(
            to=stored_email,
            subject="Reset your password",
            body=f"Click the link below to reset your password:\n\n{link}",
        )

    def reset_password(self, token: str, new_password: str) -> bool:
        with self._lock:
            self._purge_expired_locked()

            entry = self._tokens.get(token)
            if entry is None:
                return False

            if len(new_password) < self.MIN_PASSWORD_LENGTH:
                return False

            email, _ = entry
            user = self.users.get(email)
            if user is None:
                del self._tokens[token]
                return False

            user.password_hash = hash_password(new_password)
            del self._tokens[token]

            # A successful reset revokes every other outstanding token for this user.
            stale = [t for t, (e, _) in self._tokens.items() if e == email]
            for t in stale:
                del self._tokens[t]

            return True

import re, threading
from app.auth import Clock, Mailer, PasswordResetService, User, hash_password, verify_password

t1 = threading.Thread(target=go, args=('password-one',))

content.text:
All findings verified working. Summary of changes to `app/auth.py`:

- **Concurrent redemption race**: added a `threading.Lock` guarding all token store mutations; `reset_password` no longer does check-then-delete on separate steps, eliminating the double-apply/KeyError race.
- **Stale tokens**: `request_reset` now revokes any previously issued unused tokens for that user before issuing a new one; `reset_password` revokes all other outstanding tokens for the user on success.
- **Weak passwords**: `reset_password` rejects `new_password` shorter than 8 chars (NIST 800-63B minimum) without consuming the token, so the user can retry.
- **Case-insensitive email lookup**: `request_reset` now matches the stored user by case-insensitive email comparison and sends to the canonical stored address.
- **Rate limiting**: added a 60s per-email cooldown so repeated `request_reset` calls for the same account don't spam new tokens/emails.
- **Unbounded token growth**: both `request_reset` and `reset_password` purge expired token entries on every call, so idle expired tokens get reclaimed as the service is used rather than living forever.

All 3 pre-existing tests in `tests/` still pass.
